entities.summary: The MMIST CQ-10A SnowGoose is a cargo delivery unmanned aerial vehicle with the United States Armed Forces. 15 vehicles were produced. The SnowGoose UAV is produced by the Canadian company Mist Mobility Integrated Systems Technology (MMIST).
